body: Global alternative asset management firm TPG-managed Newquest Asia Fund has offloaded further shares worth almost Rs 115 crore in logistics services provider Shadowfax Technologies, through open market transactions on October 6.Shadowfax shares moved closer to their record high, before ending 0.36 percent lower at Rs 288 amid high volumes on the National Stock Exchange.Newquest Asia Fund IV (Singapore) continued its intermittent selling in Shadowfax, offloading 40 lakh shares, representing 0.68 percent of the company's paid-up equity capital, for Rs 114.8 crore.The selling price was Rs 287 per share.With this, the TPG-backed investor has reduced its stake in Shadowfax by 4.86 percentage points, or 2.85 crore equity shares, since July 2026, compared with its 11.53 percent holding as of June 2026.Massachusetts Institute of Technology sells 1.31% stake in Satin Creditcare NetworkCambridge-based Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) sold 14.54 lakh shares, representing 1.31 percent stake in non-banking finance company Satin Creditcare Network, for Rs 30.31 crore at a price of Rs 208.36 per share.Despite this stake sale, Satin Creditcare shares surged 5.58 percent to Rs 228.35 amid high volumes. The sharp recovery in the second half boosted buying interest.MIT held 1.81 percent stake in Satin Creditcare as of June 2026.Hara Global Capital Master Fund buys 0.5% stake in Mobikwik, Bajaj Life Insurance sells 0.88% sharesHara Global Capital Master Fund I, managed by global hedge fund firm Hara Global Capital Management LLC, has acquired 4.31 lakh shares, representing 0.54 percent of paid-up equity, in One Mobikwik Systems, the digital payments platform operator, for Rs 9.83 crore at Rs 227.86 per share.Bajaj Life Insurance, however, sold 7 lakh shares, or a 0.88 percent stake, in Mobikwik at Rs 236.49 per share. The transaction was valued at Rs 16.55 crore. Bajaj Life Insurance held a 2.69 percent stake as of June 2026.Mobikwik shares witnessed robust demand, hitting the 20 percent upper circuit at Rs 242.14 amid significant volumes. The stock closed at its highest level since December 2025.EOF - Direct buys 0.82% stake in RMC Switchgears from India Emerging Giants FundEOF - Direct has acquired 86,750 equity shares or 0.82 percent stake in smart metering systems maker RMC Switchgears for Rs 1.7 crore at a price of Rs 195.93 per share.However, India Emerging Giants Fund sold similar number of shares at a price of Rs 195.72 per share.RMC Switchgears shares rebounded after hitting all-time low in the last three-day selling pressure, rising 0.98 percent to Rs 196.05 on the NSE.
